segments.name: Vehicle Operations
segments.description: Runs retail automotive, recreational vehicle and motorcycle franchises selling vehicles, parts, service and F&I products to consumers.
segments.evidence: Our Vehicle Operations consists of all aspects of our auto merchandising and service operations, including our retail automotive, recreational vehicles, and motorcycle franchises that sell new vehicles, used vehicles, parts, repair and maintenance services, and vehicle F&I products.

segments.name: Financing Operations
segments.description: Provides financing and leasing to customers buying or leasing retail vehicles from the company and to its fleet management division.
segments.evidence: Our Financing Operations segment provides financing to customers buying and leasing retail vehicles from our Vehicle Operations.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for new and used vehicles, finance and insurance products and aftersales service; financing customers pay interest and lease charges.
revenueModel.evidence: We offer a wide range of products and services including new and used vehicles, F&I products, and vehicle repair and maintenance aftersales.

changes.text: In 2025 the company divested stores as it optimized and balanced its network.
changes.evidence: During 2025, we acquired 17 stores and divested 12 stores.
